paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.18, with a change of -0.16% from the prior close and -16.03% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 7, 2026.

Recent news headlines include discussions of the company's CEO departure, financial performance, and updates on Project Matador. On August 8, 2026, Stocktwits reported that Fermi said CEO Toby Neugebauer had left the company as of April 17, 2026, and that an Interim Office of the CEO had been set up. Another headline from August 8, 2026, mentioned the company's expectation to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers and the disclosure of a director's resignation. The company has also issued $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. Additionally, Cetera Investment Advisers lifted its holdings in shares of Fermi Inc. by 3,262.3% during the 1st quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing.
